Infer geometry and a camera matching the reference viewpoint, perspective and framing.
Use separate 3D meshes for architecture, furniture and visible objects, preserving colors,
proportions, placement, occlusions and materials. Do not use the reference as a texture,
background or projected image. No ground-truth calibration or other views are available.

Return a complete, runnable Python program inside one ```python code block. Each execution
starts in a fresh Blender process. Programs can use numpy, sceneact and bpy. Use SceneAct
for geometry and relationships; bpy may customize lighting, materials and camera settings.
Do not render or save files in the program: the fixed runner saves and renders once after
execution, using your active camera. Do not access external files, network or other models.
When satisfied after inspecting a rendering, reply exactly DONE. The last successful build
is submitted automatically. Budget includes all planning, corrections and review calls.

SceneAct API (all coordinates in a world frame with Z up; angles in degrees):
from sceneact import *
Scene(name='Scene'), Asset(name='Asset'), Part(name, *nodes)
parent.include(name, node) attaches an asset/part while preserving its world position.
parent.members[name] retrieves a child; parent.remove(name) detaches it.
node.clone() returns an independent subtree. scene.replicate(name, new_name) duplicates an asset.
box(size=(x,y,z), center=(x,y,z), color=(r,g,b), opacity=1)
ball(radius, center=(0,0,0), color=(1,1,1), opacity=1)
rod(radius, start=(x,y,z), end=(x,y,z), color=(1,1,1))
rod(radius, length=h, center=(0,0,0), axis='+z', color=(1,1,1))
fillet_box(size=(x,y,z), radius=r, center=(0,0,0), color=(1,1,1))
sweep_tube(points=[(x,y,z), ...], radius=.03, color=(1,1,1))
assemble(nodes, name='Assembly') groups shapes without merging their meshes.
fuse(*nodes), subtract(base,*cutters), overlap(*nodes), exclusive(left,right) construct solids.
node.move(offset), node.turn(axis, degrees, pivot=None), node.resize(factors, pivot=None)
modify a node and its descendants. node.turn(euler=(rx,ry,rz)) applies X, then Y, then Z.
Default rotation/scale pivot is the geometry's world-space bounding-box center.
shifted(node, offset), turned(node, axis, degrees, pivot=None, euler=None),
resized(node, factors, pivot=None) perform the same operations on independent copies.
node.paint(color, opacity=1) applies color to the subtree; node.rgba reads its finish.
node.centroid, node.dimensions, node.limits give AABB center, size, (minimum,maximum).
node.landmark('top'), node.landmark('front_left_bottom') return bounding-box anchors.
node.extreme(direction) returns a support point; projected_span(node,direction) returns bounds
along a unit direction; projected_width(node,direction) returns their difference.
snap(node, target, source_anchor='bottom', target_anchor='top', offset=(0,0,0)) returns a copy.
A target can also be a world point; then omit target_anchor.
abut(node, target, axis='+z', gap=0) places a copy after a target boundary.
center_on(node, target, axes=('x','y','z')) aligns selected center coordinates.
offset_at(node, reference, offsets) positions selected coordinates; None preserves a coordinate.
repeat_line(nodes, axis='+x', spacing=1) uses equal center spacing, keeping the first fixed.
pile(nodes, axis='+z', gap=0) spaces bounding surfaces, keeping the first fixed.
lattice(nodes, rows=None, columns=None, spacing=(1,1), plane='xy', center=(0,0,0), order='row-major')
orbit(nodes, radius, axis='+z', center=(0,0,0), start=0, sweep=360, orient=False, rotation_offset=0)
Layout functions return assemblies of independent copies.
scene.bind(source,target,source_anchor='bottom',target_anchor='top',offset=(0,0,0))
registers a persistent relation between scene members; scene.settle() updates dependencies.
realize(scene) settles constraints and creates Blender geometry, clearing Blender first.
set_view(position,target,lens=35,sensor=36,shift=(0,0)) creates the active camera.
area_emitter(position,power=500,size=5,target=(0,0,0),color=(1,1,1)) creates an area light.
Call realize before setting the camera and lighting. Estimate the input viewpoint yourself.

Example:
from sceneact import *
scene = Scene()
table = Asset('table')
table.include('top', box((1.4,.8,.08), center=(0,0,.75), color=(.4,.2,.1)))
for x in (-.6,.6):
    for y in (-.3,.3):
        table.include(f'leg_{x}_{y}', box((.07,.07,.7), center=(x,y,.35)))
scene.include('table', table)
scene.include('floor', box((6,6,.1), center=(0,0,-.05), color=(.6,.6,.6)))
realize(scene)
set_view((3,-4,2), (0,0,.7), lens=40)
area_emitter((0,-2,4), power=1000)


Produce a compact, complete first reconstruction immediately, leaving time for
visual correction. Aim for about 180 lines and 250 expanded primitive meshes;
these are planning targets, not external resource limits. Include architecture,
all major visible objects, separate materials, and meaningful composite Asset
groups. Prioritize projected silhouettes, perspective, occlusion and large color
regions before ornament. Keep camera and major dimensions in named parameters.

Before coding, record at most six short comments with visually estimated image
anchors. Use normalized coordinates with origin at TOP LEFT, x right and y down.
Include major bounds, floor/wall boundaries, two perspective edge directions,
and a foreground/background overlap. Record uncertain anchors as uncertain.
Use the actual photograph's framing, including cropped objects and empty spaces.
Do not replace irregular visible silhouettes with generic category prototypes.
Model broad visible surfaces as surfaces with thickness, not just outline rods.

Execution reliability:
- Keep all geometry and relationships in SceneAct; do not redefine constructors
  or bypass the backend with another mesh generator.
- realize(scene) clears Blender. Create camera, lights, materials and world after it.
- Initialize the world before accessing nodes:
  sc = bpy.context.scene
  if sc.world is None:
      sc.world = bpy.data.worlds.new('Ambient')
  sc.world.use_nodes = True
- fillet_box needs 0 < radius <= half the smallest size component, including

- Each include key must be unique within its parent, including nested loop keys.
  Duplicate keys replace children. rod endpoints must differ.
- sweep_tube produces rods and spheres; use sparse control points. Avoid dense

uncertain. Preserve correctly matched geometry, groups and materials.
For brightness, distinguish a global exposure/illumination mismatch from a local

Spend correction renders on the largest visible discrepancies, not tiny details.

```python
# Chaise bounds approximately (0.035,0.23)-(0.83,0.93); head at upper left.
# Wall/floor boundary runs approximately (0.0,0.66)-(1.0,0.48).
# Long seat edges run right/down; transverse edges run right/up.
# Tall back overlaps wall molding; pillow overlaps the inner back.
# Foreground cane chair is cropped at left and bottom, around (0.0,0.80).
# Uncertain: the rear chaise legs and the lower left wall are heavily occluded.
from sceneact import *
import bpy
import math
import random

scene = Scene('Louis XV chaise room')
LENGTH = 2.35
WIDTH = 0.91
SEAT_Z = 0.63
CAMERA = (3.15, -5.6, 3.65)
TARGET = (-0.02, 0.0, 0.91)
LENS = 49
ivory = (.72, .68, .57)
fabric = (.80, .75, .64)
sage = (.32, .38, .32)
trim = (.63, .61, .49)
wood = (.20, .105, .061)
wall = (.73, .71, .64)

room = Asset('Paneled room')
room.include('floor', box((10, 9, .10), center=(0, 0, -.07), color=wood))
room.include('rear_wall', box((8, .14, 3.7), center=(0, 1.12, 1.8), color=wall))
room.include('right_return', box((.15, 1.8, 3.7), center=(2.40, 1.95, 1.8), color=wall))
for z, depth, height in [(0.08,.09,.15),(.19,.055,.045),(.30,.045,.025),
                          (1.97,.055,.045),(2.12,.075,.055),(2.43,.045,.03)]:
    room.include('horizontal_'+str(z),
                 box((7.8, depth, height), center=(0, 1.015, z), color=ivory))
for x in [-2.6, -.9, 1.85, 2.18]:
    room.include('panel_vertical_'+str(x),
                 box((.035,.035,1.55), center=(x,1.017,1.12),color=ivory))
for z in [.40,1.84]:
    room.include('panel_border_'+str(z),
                 box((4.35,.035,.035),center=(-.36,1.012,z),color=ivory))
for x in [-2.52,1.77]:
    room.include('inner_border_'+str(x),
                 box((.022,.024,1.35),center=(x,.991,1.12),color=(.77,.75,.68)))
for z in [.46,1.78]:
    room.include('inner_horizontal_'+str(z),
                 box((4.28,.024,.022),center=(-.375,.991,z),color=(.77,.75,.68)))
# Subtle cabinet seams and two small dark fittings.
for x in [-1.69,.34]:
    room.include('cabinet_seam_'+str(x),box((.009,.009,2.5),center=(x,1.032,1.35),color=(.37,.35,.29)))
for x,z in [(-1.46,2.03),(-1.32,2.04)]:
    room.include('cabinet_handle_'+str(x),rod(.014,start=(x,.98,z-.025),end=(x,.955,z+.026),color=(.16,.15,.12)))
scene.include('room',room)

# Individually laid parquet strips.
parquet = Asset('Parquet floor')
random.seed(9)
for row in range(12):
    for col in range(11):
        x = -4.0 + col*.69 + (row%2)*.34
        y = -3.5 + row*.33
        c = random.uniform(.86,1.12)
        tile = box((.68,.322,.012),center=(x,y,-.011),
                   color=(.24*c,.135*c,.078*c))
        tile.turn('z', -34, pivot=(0,0,0))
        parquet.include('board_%d_%d'%(row,col),tile)
scene.include('parquet',parquet)

chaise = Asset('Antique upholstered chaise')
frame = Asset('Carved painted wooden frame')
upholstery = Asset('Cream woven upholstery')
# Main horizontal cushion with a soft top and rounded foot.
upholstery.include('seat',fillet_box((2.24,.88,.23),radius=.112,
                                    center=(.03,0,SEAT_Z),color=fabric))
frame.include('under_seat',box((2.17,.83,.12),center=(.01,0,.465),color=sage))
for y in [-.444,.444]:
    frame.include('long_rail_'+str(y),
                  sweep_tube(points=[(-1.10,y,.52),(-.65,y,.49),(.25,y,.47),
                                     (.94,y,.45),(1.14,y,.40)],
                             radius=.033,color=sage))
    frame.include('rail_highlight_'+str(y),
                  sweep_tube(points=[(-1.09,y-.008,.545),(-.55,y-.008,.52),
                                     (.30,y-.008,.50),(1.02,y-.008,.47)],
                             radius=.009,color=trim))
# Shaped cabriole legs.
for x in [-.91,1.02]:
    for y in [-.36,.36]:
        sign = 1 if x>0 else -1
        pts=[(x,y,.49),(x+.025*sign,y,.36),
             (x-.04*sign,y+.025,.15),(x+.025*sign,y+.02,.065)]
        frame.include('leg_%s_%s'%(x,y),sweep_tube(points=pts,radius=.034,color=sage))
        frame.include('leg_trim_%s_%s'%(x,y),
                      sweep_tube(points=[(p[0],p[1]-.029,p[2]) for p in pts],
                                 radius=.009,color=trim))
        frame.include('foot_%s_%s'%(x,y),ball(.043,center=pts[-1],color=trim))
# High rounded head, supported by a substantial upholstered surface.
back = fillet_box((.15,.88,.77),radius=.065,center=(-1.075,.015,1.055),color=fabric)
back.turn('y',-13)
upholstery.include('high_back',back)
upholstery.include('rounded_back_crown',
    resized(ball(.5,center=(-1.16,.015,1.39),color=fabric),(.18,.83,.24)))
for y in [-.46,.46]:
    frame.include('head_post_'+str(y),
        sweep_tube(points=[(-.99,y,.48),(-1.12,y,.80),(-1.22,y,1.22),
                           (-1.22,y,1.46),(-1.11,y,1.51)],
                   radius=.028,color=sage))
frame.include('crown',
    sweep_tube(points=[(-1.16,-.46,1.45),(-1.19,-.32,1.53),
                       (-1.20,-.05,1.56),(-1.19,.25,1.52),(-1.14,.46,1.43)],
               radius=.034,color=sage))
frame.include('crown_inlay',
    sweep_tube(points=[(-1.13,-.44,1.46),(-1.16,-.28,1.51),
                       (-1.17,.02,1.53),(-1.15,.29,1.49),(-1.11,.43,1.42)],
               radius=.009,color=trim))
# Front and far side wings sweep down from the high back.
for y in [-.445,.445]:
    panel = box((.49,.072,.48),center=(-.92,y,.85),color=fabric)
    panel.turn('y',-13)
    upholstery.include('side_wing_'+str(y),panel)
    frame.include('arm_'+str(y),
        sweep_tube(points=[(-1.23,y,1.31),(-1.09,y,1.17),(-.88,y,1.04),
                           (-.65,y,.99),(-.60,y,.91),(-.61,y,.58)],
                   radius=.029,color=sage))
    frame.include('arm_inlay_'+str(y),
        sweep_tube(points=[(-1.22,y-.023,1.32),(-1.07,y-.023,1.19),
                           (-.86,y-.023,1.06),(-.64,y-.023,1.01)],
                   radius=.009,color=trim))
    frame.include('wing_base_'+str(y),
        sweep_tube(points=[(-1.13,y,.58),(-.99,y,.49),(-.77,y,.47),(-.61,y,.54)],
                   radius=.025,color=sage))
# Decorative apron medallion and a few carved scrolls.
for x,z,s in [(-.10,.44,.065),(-.19,.46,.038),(.00,.45,.038),(.97,.43,.028)]:
    ornament=resized(ball(1,center=(x,-.463,z),color=trim),(s,.019,s*.66))
    frame.include('carving_'+str(x),ornament)
for i in range(5):
    frame.include('medallion_bead_'+str(i),
                  ball(.012,center=(-.16+i*.026,-.485,.42+abs(i-2)*.01),color=ivory))
# Loose square pillow leaning against the raised head.
pillow=fillet_box((.23,.64,.59),radius=.10,center=(-.80,-.025,1.12),color=(.86,.79,.65))
pillow.turn('y',-20)
pillow.turn('x',-9)
upholstery.include('loose_pillow',pillow)
chaise.include('frame',frame)
chaise.include('upholstery',upholstery)
# Small dark green label lying on the right half of the seat.
label=box((.095,.17,.006),center=(.63,.16,.753),color=(.025,.20,.17))
label.turn('z',-6)
chaise.include('museum_label',label)
for i in range(3):
    chaise.include('label_print_'+str(i),
        box((.045,.004,.001),center=(.63,.12+i*.015,.757),color=(.63,.75,.66)))
scene.include('chaise',chaise)

# Cropped cane chair in the lower left.
chair=Asset('Foreground cane chair')
chair.include('seat_rim',fillet_box((.67,.66,.08),radius=.035,
                                  center=(-1.65,-1.27,.40),color=sage))
chair.include('cane_surface',box((.58,.57,.013),center=(-1.65,-1.27,.448),color=(.48,.33,.19)))
for i in range(17):
    x=-1.92+i*.033
    chair.include('cane_x_'+str(i),rod(.004,start=(x,-1.53,.46),end=(x,-1.01,.46),color=(.65,.49,.29)))
for i in range(17):
    y=-1.53+i*.032
    chair.include('cane_y_'+str(i),rod(.004,start=(-1.93,y,.462),end=(-1.37,y,.462),color=(.65,.49,.29)))
scene.include('foreground_chair',chair)

curtains=Asset('Left window curtains')
for i in range(7):
    x=-2.23+i*.046
    curtains.include('cream_fold_'+str(i),
        box((.055,.11,2.72),center=(x,.57+(.025 if i%2 else 0),1.35),
            color=(.79+i*.012,.75+i*.012,.65+i*.013)))
curtains.include('bright_window',box((.36,.04,2.7),center=(-2.47,.64,1.37),color=(.94,.96,.91)))
scene.include('curtains',curtains)

realize(scene)
# Procedural weave and tiny faded pink motifs, without image textures.
for obj in bpy.context.scene.objects:
    if obj.type!='MESH' or not obj.data.materials:
        continue
    mat=obj.data.materials[0]
    mat.use_nodes=True
    bs=mat.node_tree.nodes.get('Principled BSDF')
    if bs:
        bs.inputs['Roughness'].default_value=.76
    if 'upholstery' in obj.name.lower() or 'seat' in obj.name.lower() or 'wing' in obj.name.lower() or 'back' in obj.name.lower():
        nodes=mat.node_tree.nodes
        links=mat.node_tree.links
        tex=nodes.new('ShaderNodeTexNoise')
        tex.inputs['Scale'].default_value=180
        tex.inputs['Detail'].default_value=2
        bump=nodes.new('ShaderNodeBump')
        bump.inputs['Strength'].default_value=.13
        bump.inputs['Distance'].default_value=.012
        links.new(tex.outputs['Fac'],bump.inputs['Height'])
        links.new(bump.outputs['Normal'],bs.inputs['Normal'])
        if 'pillow' not in obj.name.lower():
            coord=nodes.new('ShaderNodeTexCoord')
            mapping=nodes.new('ShaderNodeVectorMath')
            mapping.operation='MULTIPLY'
            mapping.inputs[1].default_value=(1.1,4.4,1.1)
            links.new(coord.outputs['Generated'],mapping.inputs[0])
            vor=nodes.new('ShaderNodeTexVoronoi')
            vor.inputs['Scale'].default_value=24
            links.new(mapping.outputs['Vector'],vor.inputs['Vector'])
            ramp=nodes.new('ShaderNodeValToRGB')
            ramp.color_ramp.elements[0].position=.055
            ramp.color_ramp.elements[0].color=(.48,.25,.23,1)
            ramp.color_ramp.elements[1].position=.115
            ramp.color_ramp.elements[1].color=(*fabric,1)
            links.new(vor.outputs['Distance'],ramp.inputs[0])
            links.new(ramp.outputs['Color'],bs.inputs['Base Color'])

set_view(CAMERA,TARGET,lens=LENS,sensor=36)
sc=bpy.context.scene
if sc.world is None:
    sc.world=bpy.data.worlds.new('Ambient')
sc.world.use_nodes=True
sc.world.node_tree.nodes['Background'].inputs['Color'].default_value=(.72,.75,.79,1)
sc.world.node_tree.nodes['Background'].inputs['Strength'].default_value=.32
area_emitter((-3.4,-.1,3.0),power=450,size=2.5,target=(-.2,0,.6),color=(1,.94,.83))
area_emitter((1,-3,3.6),power=90,size=3,target=(0,0,.8),color=(1,.96,.89))
sc.view_settings.view_transform='AgX'
```
